content.title: Powerful Speech: Irish Taoiseach Micheál Martin Speaks at US Capitol St. Patrick’s Event | AC1F
content.text: Irish Taoiseach Micheál Martin addressed Congress at the St. Patrick’s Day Friends of Ireland luncheon at the U.S. Capitol. Martin highlighted the deep historic and economic ties between Ireland and the United States, praised bipartisan efforts for peace in Northern Ireland, and celebrated Irish-American contributions to U.S. society.
